description: Looks up a German company by an identifier and returns its profile and its company_number_norm, the key the other company tools take. Intended for requests where the user gives a register number with court ('HRB 12345 Hamburg', 'Amtsgericht Köln HRB 5604'), an EUID ('DEK1101R.HRB52093'), an LEI (20 characters), a German VAT ID ('DE117663151') or a MaStR actor ID ('ABR912345678901') and wants to know which company it is. When the identifier is unique, the profile and ready follow-up calls are returned; when it matches several companies (status 'conflict'), all candidates are listed and none is picked. A register number without the court (e.g. a bare 'HRB 12345') cannot be resolved. Example questions (German users): 'Wer steckt hinter DEK1101R.HRB52093?', 'Finde die Firma mit USt-IdNr. DE117663151.', 'HRB 52093 Amtsgericht Hamburg: was ist das für eine Firma?'

art.description: Kennungsart — optional, wird automatisch erkannt wenn weggelassen. Angeben, wenn die automatische Erkennung nicht greift.

kennung.description: Freie Eingabe: Registernummer mit Gericht ('HRB 12345 Hamburg', 'Amtsgericht Köln HRB 5604'), EUID ('DEK1101R.HRB52093'), LEI (20-stelliger ISO-17442-Code), USt-IdNr. ('DE117663151') oder MaStR-Akteur ('ABR912345678901').

name: find_company
title: Firma anhand einer Kennung finden
